tagline.en: Offline Music Player — FLAC, MP3 & More
tagline.zh-Hans: 离线音乐播放器 — 支持 FLAC、MP3 等

shortDescription.en: A silky-smooth offline music player for iPhone and iPad. One of the most fluid experiences closest to Apple Music's native app. Tiny install size under 10 MB. Import FLAC, MP3, AAC and more. No ads, no account, no tracking.
shortDescription.zh-Hans: 一款丝般顺滑的 iPhone / iPad 离线音乐播放器。最接近 Apple Music 原生 App 的丝滑体验之一。安装包仅不到 10 MB。支持 FLAC、MP3、AAC 等格式。无广告、无账号、无追踪。
